quote: Respiration being disturbed, the mind becomes disturbed. By restraining respiration, the Yogi gets steadiness of mind.
meaning: When your breath is shaky, your mind is shaky too. Slow, calm breathing makes a calm mind.

quote: 49 studies: yoga lowered blood pressure. With breathing and rest added, the drop was almost twice as big.
meaning: The breath is not an extra. Yoga with breathing and rest helped blood pressure most.

quote: Whose outward breath and inward breath are drawn / Equal and slow through nostrils still and close
meaning: A calm person breathes in and out the same length, slow and quiet, through the nose.

quote: 3,959 heart attack patients. Gentle yoga with breathing helped them a little: better health, back to daily life sooner.
meaning: No harm was reported. Ask your heart doctor before you start.

quote: People with an irregular heartbeat did yoga for 3 months. Their bad heartbeat episodes dropped from 3.8 to 2.1.
meaning: A small study, but they also felt less worried and less sad.

quote: The breathing of the true man comes (even) from his heels, while men generally breathe (only) from their throats.
meaning: Wise people breathe deep and quiet. Most people breathe only from the throat.

quote: 15 studies, 1,048 people with asthma: yoga probably helped a little with symptoms and daily life.
meaning: Use yoga next to your asthma medicine. Never instead of it.

quote: 11 studies, 586 people with sick lungs (COPD): yoga breathing helped them walk farther and breathe out more air.
meaning: The gains came from pranayama. Sick lungs can still learn.

quote: Yet in the midst of my difficult breathing I never ceased to rest secure in cheerful and brave thoughts.
meaning: Seneca had asthma. Even when breathing was hard, he kept his mind calm and brave.
